summary: Clarify the vision, constraints, and stakeholders before delivery begins.
guidelines: Capture the problem statement in one sentence.
Outline success metrics or signals of value.
Record blockers that could prevent kickoff.
questions: Which teams or leaders are sponsoring this initiative?
What user pains or opportunities motivated the effort?
How will we know if the initiative should stop or pivot?
checklist: Align on scope boundary and exclusions.
Note external deadlines or events that influence timing.
